summary: REQ-26 appears implemented by adding a UPI deep-link handler in BillingPage using pa=6205684456@axl and showing an English toast on likely deep-link failure. REQ-27 appears implemented by adding generated preview state and rendering logic fed by a new preview generator; however, the diff shows generation is simulated client-side via setTimeout rather than integrating with an actual generation-completes event.

hallucinated_features.description: Client-side simulated design generation with deterministic SVG data-URL previews (3 variations) instead of using whatever existing/real generation mechanism completes.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-27 asks to render generated images after generation completes, but does not request replacing the generation process with a simulated timeout and locally generated SVG previews.
